labels.name: idea
labels.description: idea intake — refined into a context bundle before stories

checks.title: git repository with a GitHub remote
checks.remedy: connect/add the GitHub remote: git remote add origin <host>/<owner>/<name>

checks.title: gh CLI authenticated with required scopes
checks.remedy: gh auth refresh -s <missing-scope> (repo, project, read:org)

checks.title: default branch protected by an active ruleset, bypass = the factory bot only
checks.remedy: create an active branch ruleset (PR + approval + required checks) with the factory bot App as the only bypass actor

checks.title: lifecycle labels created
checks.remedy: create the missing labels (onboard apply-labels upserts the registry set)

checks.title: idea front door: issue form + idea label
checks.remedy: add .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/idea.yml and ensure the idea label exists

checks.title: Projects v2 board linked with the Stage field
checks.remedy: create/link the Projects v2 board and add a Stage single-select field with the pipeline states as options

checks.title: kit installed under factory/ (v0.1-S3 surface)
checks.remedy: install the kit surface under factory/ (tools, gates, templates, locks, ledger seed) and re-run verify

checks.title: ledger seeded + renders pass
checks.remedy: seed factory/ledger/events.jsonl (empty is valid) and let verify regenerate the renders

checks.title: toolchain present: python3 >= 3.11, git, gh
checks.remedy: install the missing toolchain component (python3 >= 3.11, git, gh)

checks.title: config present and parsed: workspace.toml + environments

verify.name: config_validator (workspace + environments + pin resolution against the kit root)

checks.remedy: fix the validator findings in workspace.toml / environments/*.toml and re-run verify

checks.title: KICKOFF.md present + PREFLIGHT.md written by this run
checks.remedy: create factory/KICKOFF.md from the kit cold-start template; PREFLIGHT.md is regenerated by every verify

checks.title: secrets posture documented
checks.remedy: run apply / document where credentials live and ignore secret-ish paths in .gitignore

checks.title: test environment runnable (attest)
checks.remedy: run: onboard attest C-13 --by <you> --note "<command|manual>"

checks.title: working agreement recorded
checks.remedy: record the human touchpoints in factory/KICKOFF.md and ship factory/locks/OVERRIDE.example

checks.title: registry + kit version recorded, no drift

verify.name: factory/onboarding-registry.json vs kit registry + kit sha

checks.remedy: re-record factory/onboarding-registry.json from the installed kit (registry_version + kit_version + declarations)

checks.title: dedicated workspace repo
checks.remedy: create the dedicated workspace repo (git init at the control home root) and push it to the forge

checks.title: workspace.toml valid + factory pin resolves

verify.name: config_validator (workspace + pin resolution against the kit root)

checks.remedy: fix the workspace.toml validator findings; a concrete pin must resolve in the kit repo

checks.title: environments valid; credential refs present

verify.name: config_validator per environment + env:/file: ref presence (values never read)

checks.remedy: fix the environment validator findings and make every credential ref resolvable (env var set / file present)

checks.title: bound target repos reachable
checks.remedy: check the binding url + token scopes; the bound repo must be reachable with the current auth

checks.title: ledger seeded at the control home + renders pass
checks.remedy: seed factory/ledger/events.jsonl at the control home and let verify regenerate the renders

checks.title: cross-repo contract-block template present

verify.name: factory/templates/ presence (the contract-block file itself lands with S4)

checks.remedy: install the kit templates under factory/templates/ (the contract-block template ships with S4)

checks.title: bot App bypass on the control-home ruleset

verify.name: ruleset(home repo from origin remote, default_branch)

checks.remedy: install the factory bot App on the workspace repo and make it the only ruleset bypass actor

checks.title: board Stage options = state names
checks.remedy: add the missing pipeline states as Stage options on the board

checks.title: Storybook builds locally (attest)
checks.remedy: run: onboard attest U-1 --by <you> --note "<storybook build command>"

checks.title: visual review path defined (attest)
checks.remedy: run: onboard attest U-2 --by <you> --note "<how a human sees a screen>"

checks.title: human adapter prerequisites (attest)
checks.remedy: run: onboard attest A-1 --by <you> --note "editor + shell + git identity ready"

checks.title: hermes adapter available (attest)
checks.remedy: run: onboard attest A-2 --by <you> --note "hermes runtime + dispatch usable"

checks.title: claude-code adapter prerequisites (attest)
checks.remedy: run: onboard attest A-3 --by <you> --note "claude CLI installed + authenticated"

checks.title: codex adapter prerequisites (attest)
checks.remedy: run: onboard attest A-4 --by <you> --note "codex CLI installed + authenticated"

checks.title: api-direct adapter prerequisites (attest)
checks.remedy: run: onboard attest A-5 --by <you> --note "endpoint + token configured"

checks.title: copilot adapter prerequisites (historical, attest)
checks.remedy: run: onboard attest A-6 --by <you> --note "coding agent assignable"

checks.title: CI workflow runs suite+gates on PRs
checks.remedy: add a CI workflow that runs the test suite and gate scripts on pull requests

checks.title: branch naming convention documented
checks.remedy: document the story/<id>-<slug> branch convention in factory/KICKOFF.md

checks.title: machines layout matches the runbook
checks.remedy: confirm each machine keeps the canonical workspace layout (worktrees disposable)
